purpose: Freeze the non-retrieval inputs that Variant C must reuse.

source_context.contract: bounded source/flow lines, detected guards, and static action_blocks_sink facts

local_llm_identity.execution_requirement: Before any new B or C run, query the local Ollama metadata endpoint and fail the run unless its exact digest equals this value; record the observed Ollama version and model metadata in the new run manifest.

verdict_policy.false_positive_requirement: A FALSE_POSITIVE requires a validated effective barrier.
verdict_policy.true_positive_requirement: A TRUE_POSITIVE is rejected when a validated effective barrier exists.
verdict_policy.evidence_requirement: Citations must reference supplied context line IDs; every detected guard requires exactly one consistent assessment.
verdict_policy.failure_result: Malformed JSON, schema violations, missing or invalid citations, contradictory guard evidence, invalid knowledge IDs, missing context, and Ollama transport failures yield UNCERTAIN.
verdict_policy.knowledge_validation: Variant B permits no knowledge IDs; its schema is bound to knowledge_used.maxItems=0.

invariance_requirement: Variant C must preserve every field in this contract and may differ only by a separately validated, attributable retrieved_knowledge bundle.
